accepted.summary: Restricted Entry Interval (REI) is 48 hours; do not enter treated areas within this period.
accepted.quote: Do not enter or allow worker entry into treated areas during the Restricted -Entry Interval (REI) of 48 hours.

accepted.applies_to: agricultural use in areas with average rainfall less than 25 inches per year
accepted.summary: In low-rainfall areas (<25 in/year), REI extends to 72 hours; do not enter treated areas within this period.
accepted.quote: The REI is 72 hours in areas where average rainfall is less than 25 inches per year.

accepted.summary: Release height cannot exceed 10 ft above vegetative canopy unless greater height necessary for pilot safety.
accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 10 feet above the vegetative canopy, unless a greater application height is necessary for pilot safety.

accepted.summary: Use fine to medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572.I)
accepted.quote: For all applications, applicators are required to use a fine to medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572.I).

accepted.summary: Nozzle height must not exceed 3 feet above ground or crop canopy.
accepted.quote: Apply with the nozzle height recommended by the manufacturer, but no more than 3 feet above the ground or crop canopy.

accepted.summary: Wind speed must not exceed 10 mph at application site.
accepted.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 10 miles per hour at the application site.

accepted.summary: Do not apply during temperature inversions.
accepted.quote: Do not apply during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: Prohibits applying through any type of irrigation system.

accepted.summary: Limits annual application to 2.0 lb ethephon AI per acre per year.
accepted.quote: Do not apply more than 2.0 lb ethephon AI per acre per year.

accepted.summary: Prohibits application if rain is expected within 6 hours due to potential reduction in product performance.
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product if rain is expected within 6 hours as product performance may be reduced.

accepted.summary: Prohibits planting rotation crops within 30 days after application unless used as cover crops only (no harvest for food/feed).
accepted.quote: Rotation Crop Restrictions: Do not plant back another crop within 30 days after application.

accepted.summary: Recommends applying a defoliant before this product to facilitate boll and foliage coverage.
accepted.quote: It is recommended that an application of a defoliant be made BEFORE an [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application to facilitate boll and foliage coverage by this product.

accepted.summary: Requires minimum spray volume of 10 gallons per acre for ground application.

accepted.quote: By air: Apply in a minimum spray volume of 2 gal/A (5 gal/A in AZ and CA).
